species.real: Cardigan Bay in west Wales holds one of the largest groups of bottlenose dolphins in Britain, and they are often seen from the harbour wall at New Quay.
species.name: Dolphlet

dex.text: Leaps out of the bay just to see if you noticed. Has a name, a whistle and no time for anyone who forgets it.
dex.fact: Each bottlenose dolphin develops its own signature whistle, a bit like a name.

species.real: Dolphin calves are born tail first, so they don't drown on the way out, and the mother nudges the newborn up to the surface for its first breath.
species.name: Bayrunner

dex.text: Races the ferry for fun and wins every time. Sleeps with half a brain on watch, which is more than the ferry crew manage.
dex.fact: Dolphins can sleep with one half of the brain at a time, so the other half keeps them swimming and breathing.
